selection: exact evidenceRunId with exactly two completed sequence 1/2 facts

lock.transactionBoundary: bounded polling with each database query executed read-only

cancellation: cancel bounded polling and emit a failed proof; never synthesize evidence
idempotency: repeated collection is read-only and content-addressed custody refuses overwrite
checksums: canonical hashes bind forbidden-domain counts, release SHA, API image digest and database identity
exitCondition: retire after Stage1 billing-maintenance evidence is no longer an active acceptance gate
